summary: Split out of MPI-809: the desktop specs are what writes the bare %TEMP% entry into the real registry, and the unit fixtures are what makes that entry expensive.
Root cause found: buildServerEnv in main.js overwrites a pre-set APP_DOCUMENTS, so a desktop spec cannot isolate its Documents folder and every run writes the real registry.
Registry half shipped and verified: a desktop run no longer writes the real project-paths.json. Fixture-litter half split to MPI-813.
